caption: The drawing consists of a floral pattern divided into two sections by a vertical and a horizontal line, with both sections featuring intertwining green stems and leaves, and numerous red flowers. The flowers have multiple layered petals with white highlights or accents, while the leaves are solid green. The background is a light beige color, filled with diagonal parallel lines indicating shading. In the left section, a thick, curved green stem crosses from the bottom left to the top center, with red flowers and green leaves branching off. The right section shows a more intricate arrangement of overlapping green stems, red flowers, and green leaves, with a larger central flower that has a white center. Faint, light gray outlines of smaller flowers are present in the background of both sections. The overall composition is contained within a square frame, and the patterns are symmetrical in style but not identical in arrangement.
title: Quilt
